name: antigravity-codex-monitor
description: Monitor Codex CLI tasks, live commands, syntax-colored diffs, and token telemetry in an Antigravity side pane.
author: Lyl101010

interface.shortDescription: Monitor Codex CLI tasks live in Antigravity.
interface.longDescription: The Antigravity side pane shows live Codex CLI commands, exit codes, syntax-colored diffs, and token and cache metrics from local logs. The bundled codex-worker skill delegates scoped coding and testing tasks to the local Codex CLI on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
capabilities: Live command and syntax-colored diff streaming
